title: Classify all depth-three connector count vectors and unequal-price optima
body:
## Summary

Classify every feasible call-count vector of the unsigned depth-three dirty chain and obtain its exact positive unequal-price tariff. Claim type: scoped proof with a finite certificate. No new κ or supplier admission.

For `z1 += B1 x`, `z2 += B2 z1`, `y += B3 z2`, arbitrary dirty rows and arbitrary compatible linear maps, the target is `y += c B3 B2 B1 x` with both intermediates restored. Let S=p1+p2+p3 for positive complete-call prices.

```text
(m,c)       minimal count vectors                    minimum bill
(2,1)       (2,4,2)                                 2S + 2p2
(3,2)       (6,3,3), (3,6,3), (3,3,6)               3S + 3 min(p)
(4,3)       (8,4,4), (4,8,4), (4,4,8)               4S + 4 min(p)
otherwise   (m,m,m)                                 mS
```

Every feasible count vector has coordinates divisible by m and dominates one of the listed vectors; every such vector is attained by identity padding. The new characteristic-three/four alternatives have respectively 108/180/108 and 3520/4288/3520 literal words. Cheapest-price ties add their counts.

PR4249 supplies the credited balanced construction, unit-price exception law and source-doubled repairs in characteristics three and four. The other doubling choices complete those alternatives here. ToikY's merged PR1662 already proves the binary weighted formula in a broader workspace model; that formula is not new here. The contribution adds the complete count classification, exceptional alternatives and exact multiplicities. The complete-call contract retains Ross Richardson's PR943/PR934 lineage. Only `research/chain-tariff/` is added, based on `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority revision 7.

## Evidence

Before: the unit-length law did not determine which operation could absorb the extra calls at unequal prices. After: the count classification proves the optimum for words of arbitrary length. At m=3,c=2 and prices (1,10,10), doubling the first operation costs 66; doubling the middle costs 93.

Local CPython 3.12.15 / macOS 27.0.1 arm64 passes ordinary and optimized full checks, each about four seconds, below the registered 180-second limit. These are check durations. Output: `PASS_CHAIN_TARIFF` with 2,795,820 enumerated literal words, 2,998 count/coefficient cases, 33,232 rational-price cases, 384 independent weighted shortest-path minima, 4,500 dirty noncommuting basis/mixed cases, 270 identity paddings and 102 negative controls.

The count DP and independent integer position census agree on every residue multiplicity. Dijkstra searches the whole UT4 group without using the proposed Pareto profiles. The package runner, committed-byte/source-history preflight and official export integrity check pass. Both Git-free modes also pass on the read-only committed export, with all eight exported files unchanged. A separately corrupted export input is rejected by its source hash. The receipt is generated from scientific outputs and all package/live-input SHA-256 values.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/chain-tariff/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/chain-tariff/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/chain-tariff
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/chain-tariff --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 path may replace the local path. Both direct commands write nothing. No pending executable or foreign Git object is needed; PR4249's credited construction is restated in the written proof.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The count cone is a written all-characteristic proof, with finite enumeration for the small-characteristic exclusions and multiplicities. Executed construction checks stop at m=32; the bounded helper supports m<=128. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Ruff is unavailable, and no external static analyzer was run. Python's bounded dynamic allocations are documented in PROOF.md.

The tariff covers the three complete calls at fixed prices. Word-dependent admission, dispatch, coefficient preparation, routing, precision, stock and supplier/outer transfer remain additional obligations. No actual supplier caller, selected cold replay, formal build or complete multiplication theorem is supplied. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Open next questions

1. Derive a closed form for balanced minimum-word multiplicities for arbitrary m, retaining both pair constraints and the triple coefficient.
2. Pin one actual caller with two dirty intermediates and compare full physical costs for these words.

## Related open work

- #4249, head `03b8a19d7442edebb3565064631f6ca2408d731e`: immediate depth-three predecessor. Unit prices recover 8/12/16 exceptional calls and 3m otherwise, checked numerically for all nonzero coefficients through m=32. The count cone and unequal-price alternatives extend its result.
- #4263: concurrent depth-four finite certificates attain 4m for 6<=m<=32. The same chain family has one more level; no count or tariff is shared, and no numerical agreement is claimed.
- #4236: depth-two multiplicity law; its 2m minimum is consistent with the shared per-letter floor. It does not supply the three-operation multiplicities counted here.
- #4189: depth-two F3 predecessor; its six-call optimum is a different chain length and no identical multiplicity is compared.
- #1930: persistent three-stage prefix chain without restored intermediates. Its one-call-per-map bill concerns a different contract, so no same-quantity comparison is made.
- #4241 and #4233: signed six-operator multi-output tariff. Their target and alphabet differ; no identical tariff is compared.

The hosted log contains both `PASS_CHAIN_TARIFF` outputs and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. No check failed. Both registered commands and all package/source-history checks also pass locally; no obligation was deferred solely to CI.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. The isolated research package can be reverted.

Blast radius: package. No shared verifier, source archive, upstream file or selected result changes.
